integrity: The claim is reconstructed from the printed replicator equations. Exact residuals, determinant, characteristic polynomial, and eigenvalues are replayed by the bundled checker; the open-parameter conclusion follows analytically from the implicit-function theorem.
scientific_limitations: The explicit interior equilibrium uses an admissible constructed parameter vector, not the motivating paper's numerical calibration.
The trace-zero argument classifies hyperbolic interior equilibria as saddle-type but does not classify nonhyperbolic interior equilibria.
No global basin-separatrix theorem is claimed.
The optional state-dependent synergy extension is outside the proof.
title: A persistent interior saddle omitted from a tripartite green-innovation game
